Once upon a time-travel leap, Mu Caiwei, the gold-medal bodyguard, turned into a poor peasant girl, Mu Caiwei, who starved to death.
With nothing to their name, and an empty rice vat, facing a skinny, malnourished mother and a bunch of hungry younger siblings, Mu Caiwei rolled up her sleeves and shouted, “Sister's going to get rich!”
Although she had followed a proud and aloof path in her past life, times were now different.…
unholy-player:
(Warning: This novel has an r18 tag and contains mature content.)
Adyr, once a notorious serial killer, met a brutal end and welcomed death as the final judgment for his sins.
But he awoke in a parallel Earth, where the rich alter their genes and superhumans are the norm.
Believing some unknown force had given him a second chance, Adyr buried the monster within and chose a quiet, normal life.
For eighteen years, he lived in poverty with his family, suppressing his urges and forcing himself to be human.
Until the day he entered a new VRMMORPG.
A game that doesn’t just alter virtual stats but mutates real genes and pushes players toward evolution.
And with every evolution, his bloodlust surfaced again, turning him back into the villain he once was.
urban-god-of-war-the-live-in-son-in-law:
He once stained the rivers and mountains with blood, his brilliance unparalleled.
Unexpectedly, he encountered a great calamity, a dragon trapped in shallow waters, everyone thought he was nothing more than a useless son-in-law.
But how could Gold Scales belong to a mere pond? The returning king, under the name of Frenzied Son-in-Law, with the War God’s stature, swept across the Eight Desolations of the Four Realms, the world trembled beneath his feet!
